name: JW Marriott Parq Vancouver
insider_take: This luxury tower rises above Vancouver's entertainment district, where world-class gaming meets sophisticated urban living in the heart of the city's most dynamic neighborhood.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Parq Vancouver is part of the massive Parq Vancouver complex - Western Canada's premier integrated resort featuring two luxury hotels, a casino, and multiple dining venues all under one roof. The hotel's sleek 60-story tower offers breathtaking views of the North Shore mountains, English Bay, and Vancouver's glittering skyline. Its location in the entertainment district puts you steps from BC Place Stadium, Rogers Arena, and the vibrant Yaletown neighborhood.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 40+ for unobstructed mountain and water views, and time your visit during hockey season to catch a Vancouver Canucks game just two blocks away at Rogers Arena.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Honey Salt restaurant offers locally-inspired West Coast cuisine, while the rooftop provides one of Vancouver's most Instagram-worthy sunset spots. The integrated Parq Casino below features over 600 slot machines and 75 table games, making it Canada's largest casino floor outside of Ontario.
pros: Prime downtown Vancouver location with panoramic city and mountain views
Integrated entertainment complex with casino, dining, and nightlife venues
Spacious modern rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and luxury amenities
Multiple award-winning restaurants and rooftop dining experiences
cons: Casino environment may not appeal to all guests
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime location
